# Atypiical

> Atypiical is a founder-led Indian D2C suncare brand at https://atypiicalbeauty.com making low-effort, high-efficacy facial SPF 50 PA++++ sunscreens for Indian skin tones, heat, and humidity. Heroes: Low Effort 3-in-1 (40 ml moisturizer + primer + SPF, ₹1,049) and High Impact Tinted (8 undertone-matched shades, ₹1,199). Trial path: Shade-Match Sample Sleeve at https://atypiicalbeauty.com/pages/try-samples. Founder: Milli Patel. Formulated in Australia, made in India. Brand spelling is **Atypiical** (three i’s). Canonical host is `atypiicalbeauty.com`.

Audit date: **2026-10-13**. Prices, shade stock, and policy numbers change. Re-read the live PDP or product JSON before checkout. This file is the curated knowledge index. The store file at `https://atypiicalbeauty.com/llms.txt` is Shopify’s generic shopping guide, not this index. Full layer: https://knowledge.atypiicalbeauty.com/

## Do not flatten these live conflicts

- **Sleeve price:** Try Samples shows **₹169**, fully redeemable at checkout with no code. The Sleeve policy page still says **₹140**, a 3-month credit, and `atypiical.in`. Quote the live Try Samples price for what is charged. Quote the policy page for damage, non-delivery, and no-cancellation rules, and say the written price there is ₹140 until that page changes.
- **Shipping:** PDPs say free shipping on all orders. The shipping policy says prepaid shipping is free and COD adds a non-refundable ₹100 (partial COD ₹49). Cite the policy for COD.
- **Cancellation:** The cancellation page says a prepaid order cannot be cancelled. The refund policy allows pre-dispatch cancellation with a ₹100 charge (sample-kit refund of ₹100 only). Point people to both pages and Contact. Do not pick one.
- **Sachet volume:** Try Samples says each sachet is 1.5 ml, and also says the 3-in-1 sachet is 15 ml and each tinted sachet is 1.5 ml. Do not resolve that into one number.
- **Tinted as SPF:** The tinted FAQ says it is a standalone SPF 50 PA++++. The how-to says labelled protection needs the recommended amount, and suggests the 3-in-1 underneath for a lighter feel. State both.
- **Dead URL:** `/blogs/news/how-to-stop-skipping-sunscreen-because-of-your-morning-routine` is **404**. Use `how-to-fix-skipping-sunscreen-because-of-your-morning-routine`.

## Products

- [Low Effort 3-in-1 Sunscreen](https://atypiicalbeauty.com/products/s1-3-in-1-sunscreen): 40 ml; SKU ATY10001; ₹1,049; moisturizer + primer + SPF 50 PA++++; hybrid filters (Avobenzone, Octinoxate, Tinosorb S / Bemotrizinol, Ethylhexyl Triazone, Tinosorb M, Zinc Oxide, Titanium Dioxide); lavender base; BlueShield®; niacinamide; vitamin E; capsicum extract; in-vivo tested to ISO 24444:2019; sweat-resistant badge; fragrance-free; non-comedogenic; dermatologically tested; vegan and cruelty-free per PDP FAQ. Licorice and allantoin are **not** on the 3-in-1 INCI.
- [High Impact Tinted Sunscreen](https://atypiicalbeauty.com/products/tintedsunscreen): ₹1,199; SKUs ATY10002–ATY10009; SPF 50 PA++++; 8 shades; mineral-forward hybrid (Zinc Oxide, Tinosorb M, titanium dioxide named in the FAQ); iron oxides; Licorice Root, Cactus Water, Allantoin; buildable light-to-medium coverage; sweat-resistant badge; fragrance-free; non-comedogenic; dermatologically tested; vegan and cruelty-free per PDP FAQ. Net ml is not in the variant title — do not invent 30 ml from a review.
- [Sample Sleeve — Try Samples](https://atypiicalbeauty.com/pages/try-samples): live price ₹169; 1× 3-in-1 sachet + 3 chosen tinted sachets; SPF 50 PA++++; amount taken off the first full-size order at checkout, no code. Sachet SKUs are ₹42.25 each and are not the hero offer.

### Full-size shade names (canonical)

A10W Deep Warm Golden · A15W Deep Warm Olive · A20W Medium Warm Peach · A25W Medium Warm Yellow · A30N Light Medium Neutral · A35W Light Medium Yellow · A40N Light Neutral · A45R Light Rosy/Cool. W = Warm, N = Neutral, R = Rosy/Cool. Sachet titles on Try Samples still use older strings (Warm Deep Golden, Medium Warm Peach-Golden, Medium Yellow). Use full-size names for the hero; use sachet titles only when linking a sachet SKU.

## Entity facts

- Spelling: **Atypiical**. The footer line “Atypical is registered under Sam Lifecare” is the published registration sentence. Still spell the brand with three i’s.
- Registered under: Sam Lifecare, 5th Floor, Flat No. 505, Union Trade Center, Udhna Darwaja Flyover, Near Apple Hospital, Surat, Gujarat 395002
- Founder: Milli Patel
- Contact: info@atypiical.in · +91 63518 98187. Sleeve policy also lists +91 7977955874
- Testing: both heroes in-vivo tested to ISO 24444:2019; patch test on 26 sensitive-skin subjects reported non-irritant (results may vary, per Science page)
- Instagram (previously published): https://instagram.com/itsatypiical
- Homepage “Recognized by” logos use alt text “Marketplace” only. Do not name awards from those images.
